quickerip.name: Quicker IP
quickerip.subtitle: Network Toolkit
quickerip.tagline: Fast IP switching with presets, adapter management, system stats, speed test - and a powerful LAN scanner.
features: Fast IP switching - DHCP, static or DHCP-reserved in one click
Save, reorder and load IP presets for any device
Set DNS per adapter - Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 or custom servers
Turn IPv4 off per adapter to keep it live over IPv6 - clean IPv4 separation for multi-NIC and Dante systems
Network Locations, plus one Edit Services window to reorder, rename, hide and add services
Powerful LAN scanner - see every device, one-click Join to hop onto another subnet
Built-in speed test
Advanced connection diagnostics - bufferbloat (loaded latency) and a live packet-loss monitor
AV network checks - IGMP querier presence, PTP audio clock and clock leader, link speed, duplex, MTU and subnet-overlap warnings
Full Wi-Fi details and live per-adapter speed
Per-adapter error counters you can clear, so only new faults show
Click to copy any IP, subnet, gateway or MAC
quickerip.description: Everything you need to know about your network, one click away. Switch IP configs, run a speed test, scan the LAN, and check Dante packet loss - without opening a terminal. Built for AV techs and IT professionals.

labassistant.name: Lab Assistant
labassistant.subtitle: Auto Set QLab
labassistant.tagline: Auto levels, auto top and tail, mono and multi-output routing - and Mint cleans up audio and video cues in place.
labassistant.description: Select your QLab cues and hit Run All. Levels are auto-set to your LUFS target, output routing and crosspoint outputs are configured, silence is trimmed, and cues are numbered and colour-coded. Built for QLab 5, licensed and free.

targettrace.name: Target Trace
targettrace.subtitle: Target curve editor
targettrace.tagline: Build precise target curves for Smaart or REW - from scratch, your own measurements, or built-in presets.
features: Live Trace - love how the PA sounds right now? Hold the moment and Grab it, and the live Smaart trace becomes your curve, point for point. Calibrated RTAs land at their real SPL
Floating Trace - one screen? Float the live Smaart trace over LA Network Manager, a console editor or any EQ graph and see your EQ changes in real time, right on your EQ
Lock it to the app - the trace moves with the window, clicks go straight through to the EQ, and it goes back where you lined it up at each window size
Save it for later, edit your live grabs at any time
Import Smaart ASCII trace exports - open, drop, or paste with Cmd+V
Flatten (Cmd+F) - ease a rough section toward flat or a tilt, a step per press
Freehand draw mode with pencil cursor
Preset starting shapes - tilt, haystack, X-curve, and more
Point Spacing - re-space a curve onto a 1/1, 1/3, 1/6, 1/12 or 1/24 octave grid
Transfer Function and Spectrum curve types
Convert any curve between TF and RTA and back, with no data loss
Split View - see your curve in both modes side by side
Z / A / C weighting filter for RTA view (IEC 61672)
Curve library with TF / RTA filter and drag-to-reorder (syncs Smaart's index)
Overlay curves to compare - each at its own Smaart offset and tolerance band, with Match curve type
Save directly to Smaart TargetCurves folder
Export as REW house curve
Keyboard shortcuts - D for draw, V for Split View, T / S to switch curve type, Cmd+F to flatten a selection, Option-drag to move around the graph
targettrace.description: Build target curves from presets, draw them freehand, or import and reshape your own measurements. Target Trace gives you a visual editor for Smaart .crv files with full control. Use target overlays, tolerance bands, weighting. With one-click export back to Smaart or REW.

fetchpuppy.name: Fetch Puppy
fetchpuppy.subtitle: Fetch Music & Video
fetchpuppy.tagline: Find and save music and video - YouTube, Spotify playlists, TikTok, and more.
features: Search and save from YouTube without ads
Save whole YouTube playlists and albums, with optional track numbers
Find and save music videos for an entire Spotify or Apple Music playlist
Drag in a Spotify or Apple Music playlist - find every track automatically
Drop in a CSV track list and it finds every song
Preview and play search results, then save right from the preview
Save videos from TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit and more
Audio conversion to multiple formats with full metadata and artwork
Smart track matching across multiple sources, scored for quality
fetchpuppy.description: Search YouTube and save without the ads. Drop in a Spotify or Apple Music playlist and Fetch Puppy finds every track or music video automatically. Grabs video from TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit, and more, and converts to multiple formats.

gogames.name: Go Games
gogames.subtitle: Classic puzzle games for iPad and Mac
gogames.tagline: Solitaire, Sudoku, Minesweeper and Battle Boats for downtime on gigs. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
gogames.price: Free - $1.49 to unlock all levels and themes

stimulus.name: Stimulus
stimulus.subtitle: Signal generator
stimulus.tagline: A four-generator test signal rack for live sound: tones, sweeps, harmonics, noise, GLITS and polarity pops, plus period-matched measurement signals.
stimulus.description: Stimulus is a test signal rack for live sound engineers. Four generators, a proper master section, and measurement signals that behave the way your analyzer expects.
features: Measure - pseudorandom pink noise period-matched to your analyzer's FFT frame (32K, 64K or 128K) and a cycle-synchronised log sweep. Both loop seamlessly, and export writes exactly one frame for analyzer playback
Tone - sine from 10 Hz to 22 kHz with a log slider, typed entry, one-tap keys for common frequencies, and keyboard nudge in 1 percent steps, 10 percent with Shift
Sweep - log or linear, any range in either direction, continuous or stepped in 1/3-octave dwells, one-shot or looped, with return
Hold freezes a sweep at its current frequency and lets you scrub the held tone by ear
Harmonics - a fundamental with seven partials from f/4 to 5f on faders, for exercising a system with controlled harmonic content
Noise - pink, red/brown or white; full range or band-limited to 1 octave or 1/3 octave around a centre frequency; continuous or in timed bursts

Identify - Stereo ID and GLITS for left and right checks with their break patterns drawn on screen, a Click for aligning delays by ear, and positive-going polarity Pops in HF, full-range and sub widths

Up to four generators at once on Mac and iPad (one on iPhone), each with level, L, R or L+R routing, polarity invert, mute, exclusive solo, and click-free fade in and out. Drag strips to reorder; every strip shows its signal and where it goes
Master level with a hard limiter at -3 dBFS, a 20 dB dim for talking over the system, master fades in seconds, and an auto-stop timer
Stereo peak meters that follow every fade
Render any generator or the whole mix to WAV or AIFF at 44.1, 48 or 96 kHz for playback machines and test systems
New generators arrive muted and start at -18 dBFS. Nothing in the app defaults loud
